scope: Shared OpenWrt directed-handshake sender and target timeout isolation; no driver, package, wireless configuration or UI visual changes.
observations: Four deauth_client execution timeouts at 25.015 to 25.046 seconds; connected remained true.
Repeated directed burst messages approximately 2.2 seconds apart; 0 ACKs does not establish why peers did not acknowledge.
changes: Preserve aireplay-ng flags, bounded positive count and targeted client selection.
Budget 10 + 3 * count seconds; this is an allowance, not a universal driver runtime guarantee.
Record child PID plus Linux start token; on timeout/cancel use shared verified stop before proceeding. Unknown identity or failed cleanup remains fatal.
Skip only affected target for current round; continue group and batch, allow configured later rounds. Preserve an already usable capture.

sources.review: Finite positive count exits after directed bursts; each burst sends 64 frames each way and drains received frames. Driver TX and receive time are not bounded by count seconds.
